content_sections.heading: HBCH&RC Radiation Technologist Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the HBCH&RC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download HBCH&RC Radiation Technologist Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Radiation Technologist: B.Sc. Physics (with min 55% marks) and PG Diploma in Radiotherapy Technology from a recognized University. Preference will be given to those who have experience in a modern Department of Radiation Oncology using linear accelerators.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 30 years Age Relaxation: Age Relaxation can be given to the exceptional candidate based on the recommendations by the committee. Age and Experience may be relaxed, if candidates having good competencies and enough subject knowledge.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Radiation Technologist: Rs. 25000/- to Rs. 35000/- Per month

content_sections.heading: HBCH&RC Radiation Technologist Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HBCH&RC Radiation Technologist Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: HBCH&RC Radiation Technologist Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Radiation Technologist post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Radiation Technologist post at HBCH&RC is scheduled for 24 August 2026. Candidates should report at the venue within the specified time frame.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Radiation Technologist position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. Physics degree with a minimum of 55% marks and a PG Diploma in Radiotherapy Technology from a recognized university to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Age relaxation can be given to exceptional candidates based on committee recommendations. Additionally, age and experience may be relaxed for candidates with good competencies and subject knowledge.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Radiation Technologist role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Radiation Technologist position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 25,000/- to Rs. 35,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry your updated resume, recent passport-size photograph, photocopies of Pan Card and Aadhar card, original certificates, and one set of self-attested copies of all certificates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Radiation Technologist post at HBCH&RC will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the HRD Department, first floor, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital Research Centre, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, 530053.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Radiation Technologist post is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Does HBCH&RC offer any preference for experienced candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to candidates who have experience in a modern Department of Radiation Oncology using linear accelerators.
